events.summary: Prime Minister Ariel Sharon outlines an accelerated plan to evacuate Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, proposing that the withdrawal begin as early as next year.
Ariel Sharon reveals plans to dismantle all Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, drawing criticism from his cabinet and party.

Jewish settlers say they rejected an offer by Ariel Sharon to limit settlement evacuations in return for cooperation with his unilateral withdrawal plan, while Sharon denies planning to evacuate seven Jewish settlements.
Israel's supreme court ruled that Prime Minister Ariel Sharon's Gaza withdrawal plan is constitutional, removing the last legal obstacle to the pullback scheduled for mid-August.
Israeli forces completed the evacuation of the last 25 Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip and West Bank under Ariel Sharon's disengagement plan.
Ariel Sharon says he will delay the forcible removal of Jewish settlers from the Gaza Strip until mid-August, after a traditional Jewish mourning period ends on August 14.

The US tacitly approves Ariel Sharon's plan for unilateral disengagement from the Palestinians, setting conditions including a refusal to let Israel formally annex Jewish settlements in the West Bank.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon told his Likud Party that he plans to dismantle Israeli settlements in the Gaza Strip, saying he had ordered planning for the evacuation of the 17 Gaza settlements.
A parliamentary vote to delay Ariel Sharon's Gaza disengagement plan failed, and police contained anti-disengagement protesters at a campsite.
Natan Sharansky resigns from Ariel Sharon's government in protest at the plan to evacuate settlements in Gaza and the northern West Bank.
Jewish settlers split over Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip as their leaders meet the prime minister to discuss terms for a mass relocation.

The Israeli cabinet approved Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip and a small part of the West Bank, authorizing the first ever removal of Jewish settlers from the Palestinian territories.

A Dutch general practitioner calls for Ariel Sharon to be brought to justice for war crimes, alleging he coordinated the 1982 Phalangist militia entry into the Sabra and Shatila refugee camps that led to the murder of over 2,000 civilians.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon says in a newspaper interview that Israel should have eliminated Yasser Arafat during the 1982 invasion of Lebanon and regrets not doing so, while stating Israel has no intention of harming Arafat now.
Ariel Sharon is criticized for ordering Israeli military incursions into Palestinian areas, described as the country's biggest military operation in 20 years.
Elie Hobeika, a potential key witness in the Belgian war crimes case against Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon, was killed by a bomb in Beirut along with three bodyguards.
Ariel Sharon wages a military operation on the West Bank, named 'Operation Defensive Shield', which is described as a replay of his 1982 invasion of Lebanon.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon sent troops into a Palestinian autonomous area in the Gaza Strip, destroying four Palestinian border posts, before withdrawing them less than 24 hours later under US pressure.
Ariel Sharon is succeeded by an unspecified successor amid uncertainty over his political future after he abandoned Likud to form a new party for March elections.
Polls published in Israeli newspapers show Ariel Sharon leading Ehud Barak 50% to 32% or 22% ahead of the February 6 prime ministerial election.
Ariel Sharon’s siege of Yasser Arafat in Ramallah is described as facing risks and resistance similar to his 1982 siege of West Beirut, with no clear new event beyond the ongoing siege.
Ariel Sharon becomes prime minister of Israel at a critical time for the country.

Ariel Sharon's government escalated military action against the Palestinians, including helicopter gunship strikes on Palestinian security barracks, abductions in Palestinian areas, and political assassinations in Gaza.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon appoints former army chief Shaul Mofaz as defence minister after Labour ministers resigned from the coalition government.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon came under intense pressure to reoccupy the entire West Bank and Gaza and expel Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat after a Palestinian suicide car bombing killed 16 people.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon said the first stage of Israel's offensive had ended as tanks redeployed around Nablus and Ramallah, while the siege of Yasser Arafat's headquarters continued.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon is due to meet US President George Bush at the White House, hours after Israeli tanks and troops raided Ramallah.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon said the army was preparing "massive activity" against Hamas in the Gaza Strip, following a helicopter missile strike that killed six Palestinians.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon threatens in media interviews to take action against Palestinian Authority chairman Yasser Arafat, though it is unclear what action he proposes.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon said he intended to complete the military operation against Yasser Arafat's "regime of terror," defying US calls to pull troops out of the West Bank immediately.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon orders a siege of Yasser Arafat's Ramallah compound, demanding the handover of alleged terrorists.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon flew to Washington to persuade President Bush against a return to negotiations with the Palestinians.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon's offensive in the West Bank destroyed Palestinian Authority institutions and targeted Yasser Arafat's compound, which critics said aimed to erase the eight-year period of Arafat's rule.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon returns from Washington facing options including expelling Yasser Arafat, invading the Gaza Strip, or escalating raids on West Bank towns, with no ceasefire among the choices.

events.summary: Jewish settlers split over Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip as their leaders meet the prime minister to discuss terms for a mass relocation.
Prime Minister Ariel Sharon outlines an accelerated plan to evacuate Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, proposing that the withdrawal begin as early as next year.
Ariel Sharon says he will delay the forcible removal of Jewish settlers from the Gaza Strip until mid-August, after a traditional Jewish mourning period ends on August 14.

The Israeli cabinet approved Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip and a small part of the West Bank, authorizing the first ever removal of Jewish settlers from the Palestinian territories.
Israel's parliament ratified Prime Minister Ariel Sharon's plan to withdraw from the Gaza Strip.

The Israeli government accepted the removal of some Jewish settlements from occupied Palestinian territories, paving the way for Ariel Sharon to fulfill a pledge to dismantle all settlements in Gaza by the end of next year.
Israel's parliament voted 67-45 to approve Ariel Sharon's unilateral disengagement plan to remove Jewish settlements from the Gaza Strip and a small part of the West Bank.
Ariel Sharon opened a parliamentary debate on his plan to remove Jewish settlers from Gaza, defending the "disengagement plan" ahead of a vote expected to split his Likud party.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon’s disengagement plan gained public support as soldiers and policemen completed the removal of Jewish families from all but four of the 21 doomed Gaza settlements ahead of schedule.
The Knesset approves Ariel Sharon's disengagement plan from Gaza.
A parliamentary vote to delay Ariel Sharon's Gaza disengagement plan failed, and police contained anti-disengagement protesters at a campsite.
Ariel Sharon reveals plans to dismantle all Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, drawing criticism from his cabinet and party.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon suffered a blow when his Likud party voted to prevent him from inviting new partners into the government, though he vowed to proceed with negotiations to expand the coalition.

Labour party leader Amram Mitzna softened his stance towards joining a national unity government led by Ariel Sharon, with Mitzna and Shinui leader Tommy Lapid set to meet to discuss joining a Sharon-led cabinet.

Ariel Sharon wins the leadership of Israel's opposition Likud party.
Ariel Sharon invites his rival Binyamin Netanyahu to join the cabinet as foreign minister in an effort to neutralize the threat to his position as prime minister.

events.summary: Prime Minister Ariel Sharon outlines an accelerated plan to evacuate Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, proposing that the withdrawal begin as early as next year.
Ariel Sharon says he will delay the forcible removal of Jewish settlers from the Gaza Strip until mid-August, after a traditional Jewish mourning period ends on August 14.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon told his Likud Party that he plans to dismantle Israeli settlements in the Gaza Strip, saying he had ordered planning for the evacuation of the 17 Gaza settlements.
Israel's supreme court ruled that Prime Minister Ariel Sharon's Gaza withdrawal plan is constitutional, removing the last legal obstacle to the pullback scheduled for mid-August.
Ariel Sharon reveals plans to dismantle all Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, drawing criticism from his cabinet and party.
Israeli forces completed the evacuation of the last 25 Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip and West Bank under Ariel Sharon's disengagement plan.

Jewish settlers say they rejected an offer by Ariel Sharon to limit settlement evacuations in return for cooperation with his unilateral withdrawal plan, while Sharon denies planning to evacuate seven Jewish settlements.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon describes the abandonment of Gaza settlements as a "painful step" but essential for Israel's future in a televised speech as the eviction of settlers begins.
Jewish settlers split over Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip as their leaders meet the prime minister to discuss terms for a mass relocation.
The Knesset approves Ariel Sharon's disengagement plan from Gaza.

The Israeli cabinet approved Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip and a small part of the West Bank, authorizing the first ever removal of Jewish settlers from the Palestinian territories.

The US tacitly approves Ariel Sharon's plan for unilateral disengagement from the Palestinians, setting conditions including a refusal to let Israel formally annex Jewish settlements in the West Bank.
President George W. Bush appoints former Presidents George H.W. Bush and Bill Clinton to launch a joint appeal for emergency donations to victims of the Indian Ocean tsunami.
Former Israeli prime minister Ariel Sharon, in a coma for almost five years, was taken home to his ranch in the western Negev.
Ariel Sharon has been comatose since suffering a stroke on this date.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon suffers a significant stroke, undergoes surgery for cerebral bleeding, and his authorities are transferred to deputy Ehud Olmert.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon was taken to hospital after suffering a minor stroke.
Former Israeli prime minister Ariel Sharon's medical condition has deteriorated significantly, with reports saying death could come in a matter of days.
Ariel Sharon, comatose since January after a stroke, is to be moved to a long-term care centre next week, according to a hospital statement.
Ariel Sharon, former Israeli prime minister, died after eight years in a coma following a massive stroke.
Doctors treating Ariel Sharon said a second round of emergency brain surgery had resulted in a significant improvement in the Israeli prime minister's condition.
Former Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon dies at age 85 after eight years in a coma following a stroke.
Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon is to be released from hospital following a mild stroke.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon showed improvement in his recovery from a major stroke, moving his left arm in response to stimulation, though doctors said it would still be days before they could assess whether he had lost his ability to think and reason.

events.summary: The director of the Jerusalem hospital treating Ariel Sharon says there is a chance the comatose Israeli prime minister could regain consciousness, though the chances are not great and his condition if he wakes remains an open question.
Ariel Sharon, former Israeli prime minister, died after eight years in a coma following a massive stroke.

Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon suffers a significant stroke, undergoes surgery for cerebral bleeding, and his authorities are transferred to deputy Ehud Olmert.

Former Israeli prime minister Ariel Sharon's medical condition has deteriorated significantly, with reports saying death could come in a matter of days.

Doctors treating Ariel Sharon said a second round of emergency brain surgery had resulted in a significant improvement in the Israeli prime minister's condition.
Prime Minister Ariel Sharon outlines an accelerated plan to evacuate Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, proposing that the withdrawal begin as early as next year.

Jewish settlers say they rejected an offer by Ariel Sharon to limit settlement evacuations in return for cooperation with his unilateral withdrawal plan, while Sharon denies planning to evacuate seven Jewish settlements.
Ariel Sharon reveals plans to dismantle all Jewish settlements in the Gaza Strip, drawing criticism from his cabinet and party.
Jewish settlers split over Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip as their leaders meet the prime minister to discuss terms for a mass relocation.

The US tacitly approves Ariel Sharon's plan for unilateral disengagement from the Palestinians, setting conditions including a refusal to let Israel formally annex Jewish settlements in the West Bank.

The Israeli cabinet approved Ariel Sharon's plan to pull out of the Gaza Strip and a small part of the West Bank, authorizing the first ever removal of Jewish settlers from the Palestinian territories.

Ariel Sharon condemns the killing of four Arab civilians by an Israeli soldier as a "despicable act by a bloodthirsty terrorist."
